citations.quote: # Campus Room Booking: Project Brief
Prepared by the Facilities Office, Northfield College. Synthetic example; all names are fictional. Date: 2 September 2026.
## Background

Students and staff book the 24 group-study rooms in the library by emailing the Facilities Office. Requests are tracked in a shared spreadsheet, double bookings happen several times a week, and nobody can see which rooms are free without asking.

statements.summary: Project goals including letting users see free rooms, eliminating double bookings, and giving Facilities a single view.

citations.quote: ## Goals

- Let students and staff see which study rooms are free and book one themselves.
- Reduce double bookings to zero.
- Give the Facilities Office a single view of all bookings.
**Dana (Facilities):** The main thing for us is ending double bookings. If two people can take the same room at the same time, we have failed.

citations.quote: - The Facilities Office can block a room for maintenance.

items.title: Prevent Overlapping Bookings
items.description: As a system, I want to reject overlapping bookings for the same room, so that double bookings are reduced to zero.

criteria.text: When a user attempts to book a room slot that overlaps with an existing booking for the same room, the booking service rejects the overlapping booking.

citations.quote: **Priya (IT):** The booking service will reject an overlapping booking for the same room. That part is straightforward.

items.title: Block Rooms for Maintenance
items.description: As a Facilities Office staff member, I want to block a room for maintenance, so that users cannot book it while maintenance is ongoing.

criteria.text: When the Facilities Office blocks a room for maintenance, the room becomes unavailable for user bookings during that period.

citations.quote: - The Facilities Office can block a room for maintenance.

items.title: Role-Based Booking Visibility
items.description: As a Facilities Office staff member, I want my office to see who booked each room while students only see that a room is taken, so that privacy is maintained while administrative oversight is preserved.

criteria.text: When a Facilities Office user views a room booking, the identity of the person who booked the room is displayed.

citations.quote: **Dana (Facilities):** Also, my office needs to see who booked each room. Students should only see that a room is taken, not who took it.

statements.summary: Makerspace tool library background information.

citations.quote: ## Background

The makerspace lends around 120 tools to members, from cordless drills to a tile cutter. Loans are recorded on paper cards at the front desk, tools go missing, and members cannot check whether a tool is available before they travel in.

statements.summary: Project goals.

citations.quote: ## Goals

- Members can see which tools are available and request a loan online.
- Volunteers can check tools out and back in at the desk.
- Fewer tools go missing.

statements.summary: First release header and general parameters.

citations.quote: ## First release

- Members sign in with the email address they registered with.
- A standard loan lasts 7 days.
- Power tools can only be borrowed by members who have completed the safety induction.
- Volunteers record check-out and return at the desk.

items.description: As a member, I want to sign in with the email address I registered with, so that I can access online features.

criteria.text: When a member enters their registered email address, they are successfully signed in.

citations.quote: - Members sign in with the email address they registered with.

criteria.text: When an unregistered email address is entered, sign-in is refused with an error message.

citations.quote: - Members sign in with the email address they registered with.

items.title: Browse Catalogue and Request Loan
items.description: As a member, I want to see which tools are available and request a loan online, so that I can secure equipment before traveling in.

criteria.text: When a member views the online catalogue, they can see which tools are available.

citations.quote: - Members can see which tools are available and request a loan online.
**Jordan (Coordinator):** Let's confirm the basics. Members browse the catalogue online and request a loan, and a volunteer hands the tool over at the desk.

criteria.text: When a member submits a loan request for an available tool, the request is recorded.

citations.quote: - Members can see which tools are available and request a loan online.
**Jordan (Coordinator):** Let's confirm the basics. Members browse the catalogue online and request a loan, and a volunteer hands the tool over at the desk.

items.title: Desk Check-Out and Check-In
items.description: As a volunteer, I want to check tools out and back in at the desk, so that loan transactions are accurately recorded.

criteria.text: When a volunteer processes a check-out at the desk, the system records the loan as active.

citations.quote: - Volunteers can check tools out and back in at the desk.
- Volunteers record check-out and return at the desk.

criteria.text: When a volunteer processes a return at the desk, the system records the tool as returned.

citations.quote: - Volunteers can check tools out and back in at the desk.
- Volunteers record check-out and return at the desk.

items.title: Standard Loan Duration
items.description: As a volunteer, I want a standard loan to last 7 days, so that due dates are tracked correctly.

criteria.text: When a tool is checked out, the due date is automatically set to 7 days from the check-out date.

citations.quote: - A standard loan lasts 7 days.

items.title: Safety Induction Enforcement for Power Tools
items.description: As a volunteer, I want the system to block power-tool loans for anyone without a recorded induction, so that untrained members cannot borrow hazardous equipment.

criteria.text: When a member without a recorded safety induction attempts to borrow a power tool, the system blocks the loan.

citations.quote: - Power tools can only be borrowed by members who have completed the safety induction.
**Mei (Volunteers):** The safety induction check matters too. Someone took the angle grinder last month without training.
**Jordan (Coordinator):** Yes, the system must block power-tool loans for anyone without a recorded induction.

criteria.text: When a member with a recorded safety induction attempts to borrow a power tool, the loan is permitted.

citations.quote: - Power tools can only be borrowed by members who have completed the safety induction.
**Jordan (Coordinator):** Yes, the system must block power-tool loans for anyone without a recorded induction.

items.title: Current Loans Desk View
items.description: As a volunteer, I want a desk view that lists current loans with the due date for each tool, so that I can easily see who has what.

criteria.text: When a volunteer opens the desk view, a list of current loans showing the holder and due date for each tool is displayed.

citations.quote: **Mei (Volunteers):** The desk needs a quick way to see who has what. Right now we flip through cards.
**Jordan (Coordinator):** Agreed. The desk view should list current loans with the due date for each tool.

items.title: Tool Return Condition and Damage Handling
items.description: As a volunteer, I want to record damage notes for suspected misuse upon return so that the committee can review them, while normal wear is not charged.

criteria.text: When a tool is returned with normal wear, no damage note or charge is recorded.

citations.quote: Normal wear is not charged. For suspected misuse the volunteer records a damage note and the committee reviews it.

criteria.text: When a tool is returned with suspected misuse, the volunteer can record a damage note for committee review.

citations.quote: Normal wear is not charged. For suspected misuse the volunteer records a damage note and the committee reviews it.

questions.subject: Tool Damage Policy
questions.question: What specific workflow or status updates should the committee perform when reviewing a recorded damage note?
questions.why_it_matters: It clarifies how committee reviews are tracked in the system after a volunteer logs suspected misuse.

citations.quote: **Mei (Volunteers):** What do we do when a tool comes back broken? Sometimes it is wear and tear, sometimes it is misuse.
**Jordan (Coordinator):** I honestly don't know yet. The committee has to decide that.

questions.subject: Late Returns Policy
questions.question: What observable system actions or penalties should occur when a loan is returned past its due date?
questions.why_it_matters: The requirement 'Late returns should be handled properly' is too vague and lacks concrete system behavior.

citations.quote: **Mei (Volunteers):** And late returns should be handled properly.
The reviewer has not answered this yet: "Late returns should be handled properly" is too vague to build; the consequence of a late return is undecided.
